subject: SignalBridge: request for temporary single-invoice / no-PO path
messages:
From: Alex R. <alex@signalbridge.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@signalbridge.com
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Single-invoice concession request for SignalBridge integration

Hi Markus / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the intro and the demo last week — SignalBridge is excited to connect our connector library to Redwood's onboarding flow. We're a small integrator supporting a couple of academic labs and would like to request a temporary concession on the PO requirement for the initial engagement.

Quick background: the first phase is a 60-day research integration (no more than $18,000/month). Our procurement process is slow because we invoice through a university research office; they can only issue a consolidated invoice at month-end rather than a PO up front.

Request: can Redwood accept a single monthly invoice (no PO) for the first 90 days while we finalize the MSA and university billing? We'll provide monthly statements, a signed MSA (in short order), and proof of insurance. If this is possible, what controls do you need from our side?

I've copied procurement@signalbridge.com and Marta (our legal lead) so they can provide the MSA / insurance quickly.

Appreciate any flexibility — this is a time-limited pilot and we'd like to get started next week.

Regards,
Alex R.
Head of Partnerships
SignalBridge Labs

Alex — thanks for the clear note and timing. I think we can explore a short-term single-invoice path for onboarding but Finance will need a few guardrails to accept no-PO billing temporarily.

To move quickly, please:
- Complete the attached onboarding-form and the risk questionnaire (I attached templates).
- Share the signed MSA and insurance certificate (policy amount + expiration).
- Confirm the single-invoice frequency (monthly) and an expected cap (total or monthly).
- Agree to a 90-day duration for the concession, after which a PO or prepay/contracted path must be in place.

If you can get those to us today/tomorrow we can fast-track a limited waiver. I'll loop Finance (Laura) to confirm limits. Vanessa — feel free to add commercial terms you'd like to control.

Thanks — Markus
Markus Klein

Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Approval: limited single-invoice concession for SignalBridge (conditions)

Hi all — I reviewed the submitted documents (MSA + insurance + completed questionnaires). Finance is comfortable approving a temporary single-invoice (no PO required) for SignalBridge under the following conditions: 

1) Concession duration: 90 days from the first invoice date (auto-expire).
2) Spend cap: up to $50,000 total across the concession period. If we project exceedance, we will pause provisioning until a PO/contract path is established.
3) Invoicing: consolidated monthly invoice, net 30; each invoice must include a month-to-date statement and reference to the related SOW (drive link below).
4) Evidence: valid signed MSA and current insurance (on file).
5) Controls: Redwood reserves the right to request payor verification from SignalBridge's university partner and to withhold approval if evidence is insufficient.
6) Termination: Redwood may end the concession with 7 days' notice if commercial or compliance issues arise.

Please confirm acceptance of these conditions by replying-all and we'll issue an internal waiver record (Deal ID SB-2027-001). Also attaching a DocuSign approval link for signature to make the concession official: https://docusign.com/xyz12345

Markus / Vanessa — if these terms look good, I'll mark the waiver approved in our procurement tracker and ask Ops to set the billing route.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: (Finance waiver recorded — internal doc; link above)
